claim: Patchline ships a real adopters' incident-rate dashboard, independently audited, updated quarterly. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the independently audited claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make audited-incident-dashboard-gate`.
